title: Reports build identity
responsibility: Calculates and caches the identity of the compiled reports server or identifies a development instance.

inputs.name: reportBuildIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Optional directory whose regular files are used to build the report server identity. Defaults to ownBuild(): the nearest ancestor found within six checks that contains handler.js and client, or undefined if none is found.

outputs.name: reportBuildIdentity
outputs.description: Identifies the report server from relative paths and SHA-256 values for regular files in the selected directory, and caches that result by directory string. It returns harness-reports-development when no directory is selected, the directory does not exist, or it has no regular files; later file changes are not re-read for a cached directory.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem errors propagate if the selected directory cannot be enumerated or one of its files cannot be read.
